style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright cooling sun-care skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, sky blue #86C7E8, deep ocean blue #1E5D9E and one warm sun-yellow accent #FFC02E; cool color temperature around 5600K; bright soft daylight studio lighting with a front-top key and wide soft fill producing near-shadowless clean rendering and soft contact shadows; background system of clean white #FFFFFF and pale mint #EAF4F2 for information screens plus a soft vertical sky-blue gradient #86C7E8 to #FFFFFF for hero, scene and closing screens; matte pale-grey acrylic podiums #F2F4F6, pale mint matte board #EAF4F2 and matte pale-stone ledge #E9E4DA surfaces; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with short Chinese headlines wrapped in 「」 and copy set in deep neutral #2D2D2D; consistent thin-line sun, water-drop and bubble glyphs in a single #1E5D9E line weight; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright spray-can presentation with the cap on, identical product scale and centering, and every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
